title: Cold rebuild: Restock list
summary: Rebuild Restock list from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Restock list** in *NULL and three-valued logic*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: What does this return? (SQLite shows true as `1` and false as `0`.)
steps.code: SELECT NULL = NULL, NULL IS NULL, 1 + NULL, 'x' || NULL;
steps.explain: Only `IS NULL` gives a real answer. Comparing, adding, or joining text with an unknown value stays unknown.

steps.title: Rebuild Restock list cold
prompt: Return the **title** and **stock** of every book that is **out of stock or has no stock count recorded**. Show a missing count as `0`. Sort by **title**.
Table: `books(id, title, author, genre, price, pages, year, stock)`
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
